parameters.name: --name
parameters.help: Name of the new app service plan.

parameters.name: --resource-group
parameters.help: Name of resource group. You can configure the default group using `az configure --defaults group=<name>`.

parameters.name: --app-service-environment
parameters.help: Name or ID of the app service environment. If you want to create the app service plan in different subscription than the app service environment, please use the resource ID for --app- service-environment parameter.

parameters.name: --async-scaling-enabled
parameters.help: Enables async scaling for the app service plan. Set to "true" to create an async operation if there are insufficient workers to scale synchronously. The SKU must be Dedicated.

parameters.name: --default-identity
parameters.help: Accept system or user assigned identity separated. Use '[system]' to refer system assigned identity, or a resource id to refer user assigned identity.

parameters.name: --enriched-errors
parameters.help: If true, Linux App Service plan creation failures will show context-enriched diagnostics with error codes, suggested fixes, and Copilot prompts. This flag only applies to Linux plans and has no effect on Windows or Hyper-V plans.

parameters.name: --hyper-v
parameters.help: Host Windows Container Web App on Hyper-V worker.

parameters.name: --install-script
parameters.help: Install script configurations. Provide key-value pairs for `name=<name> source-uri=<uri> type=<type>`.

parameters.name: --is-linux
parameters.help: Host web app on Linux worker. Defaults to true unless --hyper-v is specified. Use "--is-linux false" to create a Windows plan.

parameters.name: --is-managed-instance
parameters.help: Host web app on managed instance.

parameters.name: --location
parameters.help: Location. You can configure the default location using `az configure --defaults location=<location>`.

parameters.name: --mi-system-assigned
parameters.help: Enable system-assigned managed identity for this app service plan.

parameters.name: --mi-user-assigned
parameters.help: Enable user-assigned managed identities for this app service plan. Accepts space-separated list of identity resource IDs.

parameters.name: --no-wait
parameters.help: Do not wait for the long-running operation to finish.

parameters.name: --number-of-workers
parameters.help: Number of workers to be allocated.

parameters.name: --per-site-scaling
parameters.help: Enable per-app scaling at the App Service plan level to allow for scaling an app independently from the App Service plan that hosts it.

parameters.name: --rdp-enabled
parameters.help: Enable RDP. Requires is-custom-mode to be true.

parameters.name: --registry-adapter
parameters.help: Registry adapter configurations. Provide key-value pairs for `registry-key=<key> type=<type> secret-uri=<uri>`.

parameters.name: --sku
parameters.help: The pricing tiers, e.g., F1(Free), D1(Shared), B1(Basic Small), B2(Basic Medium), B3(Basic Large), S1(Standard Small), P1V2(Premium V2 Small), P2V2(Premium V2 Medium), P3V2(Premium V2 Large), P0V3(Premium V3 Extra Small), P1V3(Premium V3 Small), P2V3(Premium V3 Medium), P3V3(Premium V3 Large), P1MV3(Premium Memory Optimized V3 Small), P2MV3(Premium Memory Optimized V3 Medium), P3MV3(Premium Memory Optimized V3 Large), P4MV3(Premium Memory Optimized V3 Extra Large), P5MV3(Premium Memory Optimized V3 Extra Extra Large), P0V4(Premium V4 Extra Small), P1V4(Premium V4 Small), P2V4(Premium V4 Medium), P3V4(Premium V4 Large), P1MV4(Premium Memory Optimized V4 Small), P2MV4(Premium Memory Optimized V4 Medium), P3MV4(Premium Memory Optimized V4 Large), P4MV4(Premium Memory Optimized V4 Extra Large), P5MV4(Premium Memory Optimized V4 Extra Extra Large), I1V2 (Isolated V2 I1V2), I2V2 (Isolated V2 I2V2), I3V2 (Isolated V2 I3V2), I4V2 (Isolated V2 I4V2), I5V2 (Isolated V2 I5V2), I6V2 (Isolated V2 I6V2), I1MV2 (Isolated Memory Optimized V2 I1MV2), I2MV2 (Isolated Memory Optimized V2 I2MV2), I3MV2 (Isolated Memory Optimized V2 I3MV2), I4MV2 (Isolated Memory Optimized V2 I4MV2), I5MV2 (Isolated Memory Optimized V2 I5MV2), WS1 (Logic Apps Workflow Standard 1), WS2 (Logic Apps Workflow Standard 2), WS3 (Logic Apps Workflow Standard 3).

parameters.name: --storage-mount
parameters.help: Storage mount configurations. Provide key-value pairs for `name=<name> source=<source> type=<type> destination- path=<path> credentials-secret-uri=<uri>`.

parameters.name: --subnet
parameters.help: Name or resource ID of the pre-existing subnet to have the app service plan join. The --vnet is argument also needed if specifying subnet by name.

parameters.name: --tags
parameters.help: Space-separated tags: key[=value] [key[=value]...]. Use '' to clear existing tags.

parameters.name: --vnet
parameters.help: Name or resource ID of the regional virtual network. If there are multiple vnets of the same name across different resource groups, use vnet resource id to specify which vnet to use. If vnet name is used, by default, the vnet in the same resource group as the webapp will be used. Must be used with --subnet argument.

parameters.name: --zone-redundant
parameters.help: Enable zone redundancy for high availability. Minimum instance count is 2.

parameters.name: --acquire-policy-token
parameters.help: Acquiring an Azure Policy token automatically for this resource operation.

parameters.name: --change-reference
parameters.help: The related change reference ID for this resource operation.

parameters.name: --debug
parameters.help: Increase logging verbosity to show all debug logs.

parameters.name: --help
parameters.help: Show this help message and exit.

parameters.name: --only-show-errors
parameters.help: Only show errors, suppressing warnings.

parameters.name: --output
parameters.help: Output format.

parameters.name: --query
parameters.help: JMESPath query string. See http://jmespath.org/ for more information and examples.

parameters.name: --subscription
parameters.help: Name or ID of subscription. You can configure the default subscription using `az account set -s NAME_OR_ID`.

parameters.name: --verbose
parameters.help: Increase logging verbosity. Use --debug for full debug logs.
